name: Plovdiv
tagline: Europe's oldest living city on seven hills
summary: Plovdiv has been lived in for 8,000 years. Sit in a Roman theatre still used for concerts, walk the colourful Revival houses of the Old Town, explore the street-art district of Kapana, and climb a hill at sunset for the view over the Thracian plain. Bachkovo Monastery and the Rose Valley are short trips away.
seasonNote: Late May to early June for the Rose Valley harvest; summers are hot.
arrival: Trains and buses from Sofia take 2 to 2.5 hours.
gettingAround: Walk the old town and centre; cobbles are uneven.
cashTip: Bulgaria uses the euro since 2026; cards are widely accepted. Tip about 10 percent.
foodTip: Shopska salad, kavarma stew, banitsa pastry and Mavrud red wine.
buyTip: Rose oil products and Mavrud wine.
